name: Reference threads
tagline: The reference app's Priority, Unreads and Archive views for your agent chats, as one sidebar section.
description: A customize section that lists your agent chats the way a desktop coding agent app's activity view does: Priority first (chats that need input or approval), then Today and Yesterday headings, Mark all read and Clear read chats, and an Archive view with search and Unarchive. Settings turn on cmux's own priority bell and Settled folding to match. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
